Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding — scope question

Thanks David — quick question before we spin up the portal. We have a mix of hosted and customer-managed workflows; for scope, do you want us to include only services that handle PHI or everything that touches our data pipeline (ETL, S3 buckets, connectors)?

Sam

On Sat, May 30, 2026 at 08:40 AM David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sam — thanks for the quick sync window. For this initial Whistic/Vendr handoff we typically ask customers to include any service that stores or proxies customer data (S3, logging pipelines, analytics), plus the model serving layer if it retains prompts or outputs. PHI-specific systems are higher priority, but our evidence ingestion is easier if the first pass is comprehensive and we then prune to a minimal set.
> 
> If you prefer, we can run a two-step approach: (1) broad inventory import, (2) minimap/redaction sprint to remove non-relevant items. That lets us reuse the portal export for SOC2/SIG mapping.
> 
> - David
> Product Security, Redwood Inference
>

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@bluecrest.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding — scope question

Sam — appreciate the clarification question. Proposal below:

- Step A: Inventory import (Whistic/Vendr export) — include all connectors, S3 buckets, ETL jobs, auth proxies, and model serving endpoints (deadline Jun 4).
- Step B: Evidence minimap (automated tag + manual review) — we will identify PHI/PII touchpoints and map to CAIQ/SIG/SOC2 controls. Our output: a minimized profile with ~20 items for deep evidence collection (deadline Jun 11).
- Step C: Stitch plan — how to attach evidence to controls and where we need signed artifacts, KMS screenshots, Syslog extracts (deliverable: evidence_manifest_v1.csv).

If that works I will assign Mina for the minimap review and Marissa to lead the evidence stitching and upload. Karthik to coordinate role mapping in the portal (owner vs. custodian).

Next steps for you: share the portal export (preferred) or a quick inventory CSV if you need us to do the import. Full checklist below.

Checklist (for Bluecrest):
- Whistic/Vendr export OR raw inventory CSV
- S3 bucket names + region
- KMS key aliases used for production
- Last 90 days of Syslog samples (anonymized)
- Primary contact for evidence collection (name/email)

Happy to run a 30-minute kickoff on Monday if you want us to walk through the plan.

Thanks,
David
Product Security | Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: whistic-export-20260529.json (recommended), evidence_manifest_template.csv

Thanks David — that sounds good. I'm attaching the Whistic export and a quick inventory CSV. Jordan (copied) will be the evidence owner. We can do the kickoff Monday at 10am PT.

Two quick asks from our side: 1) can you flag which items you expect will require signed attestation vs screenshots, and 2) we need a minimal retention policy summary for evidence you will store in the portal (we can't keep customer logs beyond 90 days).

I'll upload the files to your Drive link shortly.

Sam

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding — scope question

Thanks Sam & team — jumping in with assignments and answers to the asks.

1) Signed attestation vs screenshots:
   - Signed attestation: any control that maps to administrative policies (SOC2 CC3, SIG
     privacy policies, KMS ownership) or where the customer requires proof of management approval.
   - Screenshots/config exports: S3 bucket ACLs, IAM role bindings, KMS key rotation logs, service account listings.

2) Evidence retention: Redwood's portal staging area retains uploaded evidence for 90 days by default. For customers that require longer retention, we offer a secure archive option (90/365/indefinite) under Dedicated contracts. For onboarding the default 90-day window should work — we'll annotate the manifest with retention TTL per artifact.

3) Kickoff + deliverables: I'll take the evidence minimap pass once the export is in Drive. Marissa will prepare the stitch table (sig-mapping-table.xlsx) and an initial evidence_manifest_v1.csv. Karthik please prepare a short role-mapping doc for the portal owners vs custodians (we'll need that during upload).

David — please confirm the Monday 10am PT slot and I'll send a calendar invite with a pre-read.

— Mina
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
